{{Quote|You're the one I've never doubted, your path has never veered from the light, and you've shown that it never will.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
'''Lowbacca''' (meaning "dutiful friend" in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]]<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>) or "'''Lowie'''" was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He was the nephew of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the son of [[Kallabow]] and [[Mahraccor]], and the brother of [[Sirrakuk]]. He studied at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] and was a companion of [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Anakin Solo]], [[Zekk]] and [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]]. He wielded a bronze-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Lowbacca the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was born to [[Kallabow]] and [[Mahraccor]], with his mother Kallabow being the sister of the famous [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hero [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="DK" /> While growing up, he had had two passions: [[Computer/Legends|computer]] science and the study of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk's]] complex plant life. The latter had prompted him to go alone into the dangerous lower levels of his homeworld's forests during his rite of passage to young adulthood, and to pit himself against the deadly [[Syren plant/Legends|syren plant]].<ref name="HTTF" />

Being a Wookiee, Lowbacca was a rarity among [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were even less common among Wookiees than among other species, one being born only every century or so.<ref name="DK" />

===Second Imperium Crisis===
====First brushes====
{{Quote|Really, Lowbacca! There you go again&mdash;always thinking with your stomach. ''[&hellip;]'' You Wookiees, you're all alike.|Em Teedee|<ref name="TLO">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Lowbacca18.jpg|thumb|left|125px|left|Lowbacca and Em Teedee]]
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]] at the age of 19, he went to study at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]]. Since most of the people Lowbacca would have to interact with were not fluent in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] trade language, he used a small translator [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that he carried at his waist named [[M-TD|Em Teedee]]. Later in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] it was modified to hover and followed him around flying. He became friends with [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]]. Jacen had a good sense of humour, and Lowie liked him because of this. Lowbacca's combination of computer skills, biological knowledge and desire to take on the impossible would make him an invaluable asset to the Jedi.<ref name="HTTF" />

Lowbacca unknowingly set a chain of events in motion when he discovered what eventually turned out to be a derelict [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] in the jungles of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. His new friend Jaina Solo, somewhat envious of Lowbacca's [[T-23 skyhopper]], wanted to repair the TIE Fighter. With the help of Lowbacca, Solo, and Tenel Ka, she did, but the friends didn't know that they were being watched by the TIE Fighter's pilot, [[Qorl]]. Eventually he was forced to reveal himself and he took the [[Solo twins]] hostage, forcing them to repair the fighter for him.<ref name="HTTF" />

Lowbacca ran away to his [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]] and returned with it in an attempt to intimidate Qorl into running away. However, Qorl called his bluff and critically damaged the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], forcing Lowbacca to abandon it in the jungle. Lowbacca tore through the jungle on foot for the Praxeum, losing [[M-TD|Em Teedee]] in the process. Once he got there, he couldn't communicate with anyone. He then remembered that his uncle and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were still in the system and within communicator range, delivering supplies to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[GemDiver Station]]. Solo translated the situation to [[Tionne Solusar]]. A rescue mission was mounted, Tenel Ka had recovered Em Teedee for Lowbacca, and the twins were recovered.<ref name="HTTF" />

Shortly thereafter, Lowbacca was kidnapped along with his friends Jacen and Jaina, as well as Em Teedee while on a field trip to GemDiver Station. The little droid was taken away from him, and they were brought to the [[Shadow Academy]]. There, [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Tamith Kai]] tried to exploit his anger in an attempt to turn him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. She went to such lengths as reprogramming Em Teedee to spout pro-[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] propaganda or subjecting him to arduous [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="SA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>

Lowbacca gave into his anger twice, the first time when Brakiss attacked [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and the other when he let loose a [[Force scream/Legends|yell]] that smashed a screeching [[Sonic generator/Legends|sonic generator]] beyond all repair. However, Lowbacca was able to keep himself from being indoctrinated. When Jacen freed himself using a [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]] that he had acquired during their field trip, Lowbacca used his excellent programming skills to help his friends in an escape attempt aboard the station just in time for Luke and Tenel Ka to show up to rescue them.<ref name="SA" />

Shortly after, Lowbacca joined his uncle Chewbacca, Han, the Solo twins and Tenel Ka to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a visit, staying over at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. He was introduced to Jaina and Jacen's street friend, [[Zekk]], who persuaded the trainees to join him in extracting a [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bat]] egg, which was highly valuable. They were soon ambushed by the [[Lost Ones]] gang, and Lowbacca cleared the way for all five of them to make their escape. He was later groomed for a banquet honoring the [[Karnak Alpha]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]].<ref name="TLO" />

When Zekk went missing, Lowbacca joined in the search, but there was no sign of the young [[Scavenger/Legends|scavanger]]; it would be days before they learned that Brakiss had been found and taken Zekk in for training. It was during this time that Lowbacca aided Jaina in mapping out the debris floating in orbit around Coruscant. He soon accompanied Chewbacca and Jaina to the [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite]] so as to help [[Peckhum]], supplier for the Jedi Praxeum, effect repairs. They proved instrumental in exposing the [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] Shadow Academy to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], but by then, it was too late to prevent it from retreating to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space.<ref name="TLO" />

====Hapes====
{{Quote|The Mairan ambassador formally greets you, Princess Tenel Ka. And he commends you on your capture of such a magnificent and well-trained pet, with its coat of silky brown seaweed&mdash;oh, dear! I do believe he's referring to Master Lowbacca|Em Teedee|<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Lowbacca-YJK5cover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lowbacca with his unique bronze lightsaber]]
Master Skywalker soon determined that, thanks to the [[Second Imperium Crisis|nefarious activities]] brought about by Brakiss, all of his students needed to start their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] early, the first being Lowbacca and his friends. Lowbacca found some computer parts for [[Lowbacca's lightsaber|his own weapon]] as well as an [[enhancement jewel]] to power it. The Wookiee performed well in his first test against training [[Remote/Legends|remotes]], even though the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] he donned was too small for his head. He was initially unwilling to spar with Jaina when the time came, but after some encouragement from her, he became more enthusiastic. That quickly turned to horror, however, when he witnessed the accident that [[Cho sun/Legends|cost]] Tenel Ka her left arm. Later in the night, they watched as Tenel Ka was taken home offworld.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

As days went by, Skywalker decided to take Lowbacca and the [[Solo twins (disambiguation)|Solo twins]] to visit Tenel Ka on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes/Legends]] for a month. Lowbacca could only have been surprised to learn that Tenel Ka was [[Hapan Royal House|royalty]]. The revelry was soon swept away when an [[Bombing of Fountain Palace|assassination attempt]] occurred at the [[Fountain Palace]]; a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] went off in the dining hall where the trainees and Tenel Ka's grandmother, [[Ta'a Chume]], were supposed to be that evening. Arrangements were quickly made for the trainees to take shelter at [[Reef Fortress Island]], where Ambassador [[Yfra]] would take care of them.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

While there, the [[Mairan/Legends|Mairan]] ambassador had arrived to discuss a grievance his people were having with the neighboring [[Vergill]]s. Lowbacca was incensed when the ambassador had mistaken him for Tenel Ka's pet, but rage gave way to mirth when Tenel Ka practically destroyed the Mairan with her diplomatic skill.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

All four trainees took a ride on a [[wavespeeder]], only to defend themselves against a [[carnivorous seaweed]] at [[Dragon's Teeth]]. Once safely away, Lowbacca and Jaina discovered that the vehicle had been sabotaged, and Yfra was the prime suspect. Then a [[Bartokk]] hive [[Raid on Reef Fortress|infiltrated]] [[Reef Fortress]] to finish off Ta'a Chume. Lowbacca had to defend the former [[Queen Mother]] with his lightsaber as well as his bare hands. He led the way out of the tower down Tenel Ka's [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] rope, and the group escaped through Dragon's Teeth, where they provoked the "killer seaweed" into taking out their Bartokk pursuers.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

Yfra was swiftly arrested for [[Treason/Legends|treason]], and Tenel Ka returned to Yavin to resume her [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]. To Lowbacca's delight, the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] was able to wield a lightsaber once more.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

====Kashyyyk====
{{Quote|Mistress Sirrakuk says that she will stay to help her people clean up and make repairs, but she understands that her brother Lowbacca must return to fight with the other Jedi. There are many Wookiees who can assist here on Kashyyyk , but there aren't many other Jedi Knights&hellip; and she is exceedingly proud that her brother is one of them. I do believe she's quite pleased with him.|Em Teedee|<ref name="DK" />}}
Later, Lowbacca went to Kashyyyk with Jacen, Jaina, and Tenel Ka in response to his sister, [[Sirrakuk]]'s, coming of age and going deep in the underlevels of the planet to harvest strands of the deadly syren plant. Lowbacca had done this under unwise counsel alone, and Sirrakuk wished to repeat this, as did her best friend and Lowbacca's admirer, [[Raabakyysh]]. When Raaba did, though, she disappeared and was presumed dead for a month.<ref name="DK" />

Shortly after their arrival, a [[Second Imperium]] task force, headed by Zekk, came to [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|raid]] a factory for computer supplies for the new fleet. The two parties soon met and started a skirmish that killed the Nightsister [[Garowyn]], causing her to tumble into the underlevels of the Kashyyyk forest. There, Lowbacca and the others headed off Vonnda Ra and eleven [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Shortly following, they encountered a syren plant. There, Nightsister [[Vonnda Ra]] and Sirrakuk were swallowed by the carnivorous plant, with Vonnda Ra being eaten and Sirrakuk pulling out the strands of the plant and then being pulled out by Lowbacca.<ref name="DK" />

====Yavin====
{{Quote|How are you doing, Lowbacca, old buddy? You look like you've seen some hard action.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Third Battle of Yavin]], Lowbacca fought off a cadre of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], while his partner Tenel Ka sabotaged the floating battle platform from which Tamith Kai lead her forces, causing a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] to crash into it and kill the Nightsister. While avoiding the explosion, Tenel Ka hit her head on a branch and fell from the treetops. Lowbacca managed to break her fall with his whole body, resulting in around three broken ribs and a dislocated shoulder. Jaina and [[Raynar Thul]] tended to his injuries. With the end of the battle, the Second Imperium had been defeated. Lando then took Lowbacca and his friends to GemDiver station for [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment; the Wookiee was relieved to find that his skyhopper had survived the battle.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

===Diversity Alliance===
{{Quote|I am especially honored to have a Jedi among us. The Diversity Alliance has great work to do, and you possess crucial skills.|Nolaa Tarkona, to Lowbacca|<ref name="DOG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref>}}
After some time assisting in the repairs of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], Lowbacca traveled with his friends to [[The Graveyard|remains]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in a quest to find a present for Leia Organa Solo's birthday. Unfortunately, after successfully extracting a piece of Alderaan's core, they were attacked by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] (in actuality his daughter [[Ailyn Vel]]). Lowbacca barely managed to hide the ''[[Rock Dragon]]'', Tenel Ka's ship, into an asteroid. Because of the extensive damage, he insisted on diverting all power to the last remaining engine; it was risky flying defenseless against the ''[[Slave IV]]'', but there was no option left. The crew of the ''Rock Dragon'' would have been destroyed had not Zekk come to their rescue. Once the ''Millennium Falcon'' helped the Padawans back to Yavin 4, Leia's party could begin.<ref name="SOA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>

Lowbacca and the others accompanied Padawan Raynar Thul home to the [[Bornaryn Trading Fleet]], for the young man's father [[Bornan Thul]] had gone missing and mother [[Aryn Dro Thul|Aryn]] worried for his safety. Unfortunately, the ''[[Tradewyn]]'' was ambushed by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] ship known as the ''[[High Roller]]'', prompting Jaina and Lowbacca to fend it off and destroy it with the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]'s [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]]. Further investigation told Lowbacca, Tenel Ka and the Solo twins to head right for [[Kuar]], only for the Wookiee to be wounded in the side by a [[Combat arachnid/Legends|combat arachnid]]. They were rescued from more of the beasts by Lowbacca's friend Raaba, who was revealed to have survived her ordeal on Kashyyyk. However, she had to leave after a spat with Raynar's uncle [[Tyko Thul|Tyko]]. Then the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], abducted Tyko.<ref name="DA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref>

Lowbacca was persuaded by Raaba to accompany her to Kashyyyk, where she made a recruiting speech for the [[Diversity Alliance]], an organization of aliens who seemed genuinely to ease many species from the many injustices wrought by [[Human/Legends|humans]]. She then talked Lowbacca and Sirra into joining this group, and they set off to meet the leader, [[Nolaa Tarkona]], on her homeworld of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Tarkona informed Lowbacca that his Jedi talents would be invaluable for the cause. There was almost a fight when the Wookiee siblings and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Corrsk (Diversity Alliance)|Corrsk]], but Raaba and Tarkona were able to smooth things out.<ref name="DOG" />

However, while working on the Diversity Alliance's [[Computer/Legends|computers]], Lowbacca began to question everything about the organization in which Raaba was a part of. Things came to a head after learning from Sirra of the ''[[Rock Dragon]]''{{'}}s presence in the base. This could only mean that Lowbacca's friends were here. After confronting Raaba and finding the Diversity Alliance's true purposes in the computers&mdash;weapons being gathered for an assault on [[Human/Legends|humanity]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;he retrieved the lightsabers of his fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] as well as an upgraded M-TD from storage, set up a well-timed false gas leak alarm and impersonated a guard to extract Jacen, Jaina, Tenel Ka and Raynar from the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] mines. The Padawans split up, with Lowbacca and M-TD going to explain to Sirra all that had been discovered. Lowbacca held Corrsk off to buy Sirra time as she prepared the ''Rock Dragon'' for liftoff. Together, they picked up Jacen, Tenel Ka and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] exile named [[Kur (Twi'lek)|Kur]] on the freezing night side of Ryloth; Jaina and Raynar were rescued by Zekk's ship, ''[[Lightning Rod]]''. Then they all fled to Coruscant with the revelation of this new threat.<ref name="JB">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref>

A guilt-ridden Lowbacca aided [[Anakin Solo]] in working on the diagnostic relays and regulators on Tenal Ka, Raynar and the Solo twins' [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]]. Once they were all healed, he later joined in tailing Zekk and Raynar as they searched for Bornan Thul, driving away Ailyn Vel before she could destroy the ''Lightning Rod''. Together, they joined Bornan in traveling to the [[Emperor's plague storehouse|secret Imperial bioweapons storehouse]] to destroy the [[Emperor's Plague|dangerous plague]] that could threaten humans all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lowbacca insisted that he and M-TD take the explosives into the central chamber, as they would be at less risk with the plague. However, once inside, he discovered the [[Krytos virus]] among other bioweapons; if Nolaa Tarkona acquired them, she would stop at nothing to keep separate sentient species under her thumb. Then the Diversity Alliance arrived, and a [[Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse|fight for the fate of the galaxy]] ensued.<ref name="TEP">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

Lowbacca was ambushed by Corrsk, whom he led away from the plague canisters to avoid risk of releasing their contents. After disposing of the Trandoshan [[General/Legends|general]] via [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], he and M-TD were greeted by the reprogrammed IG-88A. They soon found Bornan Thul dying from the exposed plague and locked in the central chamber, along with Tarkona. Lowbacca tried to prevent IG-88A from breaking the door open, assassin droid simply overpowered the Wookiee; only Bornan's voice command made IG-88A halt. While escaping, Lowbacca, Zekk, Raynar and MT-D ran into Diversity Alliance guards, who were mowed down by the surprise appearance of Ailyn Vel, who was hired by Tyko to ensure Bornan and Raynar's safety.<ref name="TEP" />

The Diversity Alliance was in ruins as a result of the battle, along with the weapons depot. Before fleeing with the dying Tarkona aboard her ship, ''[[Rising Star]]'', Raaba had sent a transmission to Lowbacca, asking him to wait for her in case she survived the plague. In the meantime, Lowbacca joined in the celebration for the reconstructed Great Temple. He could not help laughing upon seeing Tenel Ka kiss Jacen.<ref name="TEP" />

===Black Sun Insurgency===
During the Solos' trip to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Lowbacca, M-TD, Zekk, and Tenel Ka secretly entered the ''[[Rock Dragon]]'' for the [[Blockade Runners Derby]]. They used their combined [[The Force/Legends|Force]] ability and won the Blockade Runners' Derby. The fact that they were training at Luke's Jedi Praxeum caused controversy, but as the ship had not been modified specifically for the derby, as was commonly done by participants, after a few days the matter was dropped.<ref name="Ord Mantell">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref>

[[File:AmbushEC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Anja Gallandro, Jacen Solo, and Lowbacca are ambushed by chameleon creatures]]

Later in a docking bay some [[chameleon creature]]s, loyal to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], were stealing the [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] they had found. Lowie, the Solos, Zekk, and Tenel Ka ran out of the ''Rock Dragon'' to stop them. A few of the chameleon creatures were killed. [[Anja Gallandro]] arrived and killed one more escaping chameleon, but they ultimately escaped with the mines.<ref name="Ord Mantell" />

When Han Solo came, Anja accused him of killing [[Gallandro/Legends|her father]]. Han denied this, his children unconvinced either. Anja convinced them to go with her to [[Anobis]], onboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. (She really intended to get Han killed in the war). They landed near [[Yuos]]'s village where they were attacked by [[Knaar]]s. After Jacen used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to scare away the Knaars, Tenel Ka, Jacen, and Lowie went into the woods to meet up with the Falcon. Upon arrival they were arrested by [[Elis]].<ref name="Ord Mantell" />

Anja then went back to Yons's village with Elis's brother, [[Protas (Human)|Protas]] to blow it up, but one of the mines Protas planted detonated and killed him. After hearing this Elis was more open to negotiations, the end result being Lowie and the Solos' freedom, and an end to [[Anobis]]'s 25-year war.<ref name="Ord Mantell" />

Anja came back with them to Yavin 4.<ref name="Ord Mantell" /> She shunned everyone but Zekk and Jacen. A few weeks later, Lando invited them to come to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] so they could see the amusement park SkyCenter Galleria that he and [[Cojahn]] were working on. Upon arrival they learned Cojahn was killed (unknown to them by the Black Sun).

Lando, despite the bad news, continued with the tour he promised them. Due to lack of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] Anja told [[Czethros]] that Cojahn's death was under investigation. In the swamp simulated environment they found out that the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]] mysteriously disappeared so Lando, Zekk, and Jaina went to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] and learned of Black Sun's influence on Cloud City.

[[File:Lowbacca_Bespin.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Lowbacca around 24 ABY]]

While Lowie was in the snow environment, he noticed an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] spying on them, which they followed down a tunnel that led into an open room, where seven Black Sun [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] with images of them showed themselves, and Lowie ran down another hallway. The Ugnaught launched them down a garbage chute, Lowie grabbed an antenna and Tenel Ka with the other hand, however, Jacen wasn't as lucky and fell through the clouds.

The [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] arrived with a rescued Jacen. With the information Jacen heard (from his rescuer [[M'kim]]) and the information Lando got from the Modal Nodes they then had evidence to link [[Cojahn]]'s death to the Black Sun. Lowie looked up the holo recordings, and found a lot of the recordings deleted, but also found [[Czethros]] was on Cloud City and that he himself killed Cojahn.

When Lowie, Jacen, and Tenel Ka went to the address for the debriefing about the Black Sun, they were attacked by the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] and Black Sun mercenaries. Lowie jumped into a [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] and took off. One mercenary and one wing guard took off in pursuit of Lowie. Just as Lowie's engine was giving out, seven [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] and their [[Thranta Rider|Riders]] came and knocked Lowie's pursuers out of their vehicle and caught them. Lowie then came for a landing on Cloud City.

Lowie later reunited with his fellow Jedi Knights (all had a similar run-in) and returned to Yavin 4. Later Anja ran out of spice so she stole the ''[[Lightning Rod]]'', and flew it to the spice mines of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. They got a lead from [[Lilmit]] so Tenel Ka, Jacen, and Zekk flew to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Lowie and Jaina stayed on Kessel.

While on Kessel, an army of Black Sun mercenaries [[Battle of Kessel (Black Sun Insurgency)|took control]] of the planet and captured [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], though Jaina and Lowbacca managed to escape. They found out that while Kessel, Czethros planed to send a signal that would trigger Black Sun spies everywhere. However, Jaina, Lowie, and M-TD sabotaged his plan by destroying the transmitter before Czethros could send the signal. Lowie also helped free the prisoners and defeated the Black Sun mercenaries. Czethros fell into a vat of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and was flash-frozen instantly. The criminal was retrieved by the New Republic. As a result, the names of Black Sun spies in strategic positions of power were discovered amounting to the defeat of the Black Sun.

Following this ordeal, the Solo Twins, Anakin, Tenel Ka, Lowbacca, and Zekk were promoted to apprentice Jedi Knights during a ceremony at the Jedi Praxeum.

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|You don't suppose that New Republic Intelligence has once again drop-kicked their brains and sent us out here for nothing?|translated=1|Lowbacca to Jaina Solo (translated from Shyriiwook)|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way" />}}
When Chewbacca died at the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Lowbacca attended his funeral on Kashyyyk. Later, he and Chewbacca's son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]] vowed to take up his life debt to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after Chewbacca's [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]], but Han insisted that he was still mourning Chewbacca. Instead, Luke assigned him to accompany Jedi Knight [[Daye Azur-Jamin]] and his wife [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]], a [[Chenlambec|Wookiee]]-trained [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], as scouts in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

[[File:Lowie-myrkr.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Lowbacca during the mission to Myrkr]]

When Daye was captured on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and the Yuuzhan Vong tightened their grip on Hutt territory, however, Lowie and Tinian had to flee back into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] territory, returning to his home planet of Kashyyyk.

Early in the War he returned to Yavin 4, and trained with [[Finn Galfridian]]. He then went with Finn and the Solo's to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to retrieve a [[Dray's holocron|holocron]].

Unable to fulfill the debt to Han himself, Lowbacca subsequently stuck close to the Solo children, particularly Jaina. He took part in the [[Myrkr strike team]]'s [[Mission to Myrkr|assault]] on the [[voxyn]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility onboard the [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]] ''[[Baanu Rass]]'', and subsequently served as Jaina's first mate aboard ''[[Trickster]]''. He later became a member of [[Twin Suns Squadron]] under Jaina's command, where he earned the nickname Streak. At the [[Battle of Ebaq]], Lowbacca was stabbed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], but the wound was not fatal. By the end of the war, Lowbacca was commanding a squadron of his own, and he later bonded with a [[Zonama Sekotan fighter|seedship]] on [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] which he flew during the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]]. After the war, Lowbacca told Han he and Waroo were assuming Chewbacca's life debt.

===Dark Nest Crisis===
[[File:Lowbacca.jpg|thumb|right|100px|Lowbacca during his days in the New Jedi Order]]
In the years after the war, the Jedi went to great lengths to help the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] recover. Lowbacca worked with Jaina and [[Tesar Sebatyne]] on at least one occasion in helping to foil criminal warlords eager to profit from the war's fallout. In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], after the three boarded the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Night Lady]]'' and took down the [[Yaka]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Redstar]], they attended his trial on the maximum security [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[MaxSec Eight]]. While Jaina was testifying, the received a Force-cry from their old friend [[Raynar Thul]]. Along with most of the other survivors of the Myrkr mission, Lowbacca followed it into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and discovered that Thul was now Unuthul, the leader of a colony of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

Lowbacca was one of several Jedi who became [[Joiner]]s and were absorbed into the Killik [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. He fought for the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during their conflict with the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], and was captured by Chiss forces. He was released by [[Jagged Fel]] after the signing of the [[Qoribu Truce]],<ref name="The Joiner King" /> but the move ended up forcing Fel's entire [[Fel dynasty|family]] into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] from the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> After the truce, Lowie and Tesar [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] pirates who were hijacking abaarian [[Water/Legends|water]] shipments.<ref name="The Unseen Queen" />

In [[36 ABY]], the Killik-Chiss conflict was reignited by the machinations of Jacen Solo and erupted into an all-out [[Swarm War]]. During the war, Lowbacca, Tesar, and [[Tahiri Veila]] had endangered the security of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] by telling [[Aryn Dro Thul]], Raynar Thul's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], that the Jedi were planning to kill her son. Grand Master Luke Skywalker found out and ordered the three to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] for the remainder of the war.<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

===Second Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Lowiebyshea.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Lowbacca]]
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], tensions rose between the Galactic Alliance and the [[Five Worlds]] government of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. While Corellia was under [[Blockade of Corellia|blockade]], Lowbacca and Tesar operated under the command of Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]]. Bwua'tu had Jaina and Zekk monitoring secret [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Kiris Asteroid Cluster]], but when the two were relieved of their posts and sent to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], Lowbacca and Tesar took over.<ref name="Tempest" />

The Jedi departed the Alliance after it fell under the despotic rule of Jacen Solo, now the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Caedus. Lowbacca was one of many Jedi who fought against Caedus during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], and led a Jedi charge against Caedus's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. Caedus attempted to [[Force-meld|Force meld]] with Lowbacca in order to sense where the other Jedi Knights were. Lowbacca tried to mentally reason with Caedus while simultaneously launching a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] at the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]; the bomb hit, but a distraction caused by [[Ben Skywalker]] saved Caedus' life.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

Lowbacca's home planet joined a [[Jedi Coalition]] directed against Caedus in the battle's aftermath.<ref name="Inferno" /> In [[41 ABY]], Lowbacca went on to participate in some of the final battles of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], which ended after Caedus was [[Battle of Uroro Station|slain]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by his own twin sister, Jaina.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

===Rising Tensions===
In [[44 ABY]], Jaina and Lando Calrissian returned to the Jedi's home base on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after an encounter with the recently-discovered [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. Lowbacca was presented with a modified [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had been placed aboard Calrissian's ''[[Rockhound]]'' by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pirates in an effort to determine the [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] style and hopefully learn the location of the Sith base.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

The Jedi Order prepared to launch its [[StealthX]] wing from Coruscant to assist Luke Skywalker in his battle with the Lost Tribe. Lowbacca was one of several veteran Jedi pilots who helped command the fighter wing. After launching, the wing arrived at [[Pydyr]] and did [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] with Sith forces,<ref name="Vortex" /> who soon after escaped.<ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Visuallowie.jpg|thumb|right|135px|Lowbacca]]
{{Quote|Seriously? A Wookiee, with a lightsaber! That's just overkill.|[[Spraug]] after being confronted by Lowbacca|<ref name="Invasion 5">[[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]]</ref>}}
Lowbacca was a serious fighter who loved the heat of battle. He had a slight sense of humor, but only used it when it was necessary. Of their core group of friends, Lowbacca enjoyed spending time with [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] because of Jacen's sense of humor. Their relationship came to an end after Jacen became Darth Caedus and ravaged Kashyyyk, Lowbacca's homeworld, thus forcing the Wookiee Jedi to fight his former friend until Caedus' eventual demise.

==Behind the scenes==
Lowbacca was created by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], and featured as a major protagonist throughout their fourteen-book [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights|''Young Jedi Knights'']] series of young adult novels, published from [[1995]] to [[1998]]. He later went on to feature in several installments of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series of novels, which were released from [[1999]] to [[2003]]. A baby Lowbacca appears in the 1998 novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]''.

After the release of ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy]]'', [[George Lucas]] declared that no more Wookiee Jedi could be made in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]].<ref name="Hyperspace-''Star Wars Insider'' #79 Online Supplement">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/79/index.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #79 Online Supplement}}</ref> Lowbacca was exiled to Dagobah in [[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War|''The Swarm War'']], the final chapter of trilogy, but author [[Troy Denning]] stated that it was not permanent.<ref name="njoe">{{WebCite|url=http://www.njoe.com/index.php?id=view&sub=ex&sub2=inter&sub3=552|text=Troy Denning on NJOE.com|archivedate=20060516090458|nolive=1}}</ref> When asked about Lowbacca's sudden disappearance, [[Sue Rostoni]], Executive Editor of [[Lucas Licensing]], replied that he was busy doing 'Jedi things.'<ref>{{SWBoards|url=message.jspa?messageID=15741200#15741200|thread=Welcome some BCaT VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2006-10-05|time=3:36 PM|quote=I don't know for sure. He's busy doing Jedi things.}}</ref> He has subsequently appeared in several novels.
